description: No clean rule found. Clearest trigger: a bottom-row three in columns 2-4 (or 2 and 4 with 3 empty) of one colour, usually the opponent's, with cells (0,1) and (0,5) both still empty (a double threat on the bottom row). It also fires weakly more often when the opponent has a must-block or there are threat cells in column 4. Most mid and late game firing has no pattern I could identify.
effect: none measurable: zeroing or maxing it changes every column's probability by at most 0.02 (5 positions).
notes: 4 score calls. p1 must-block: F1 0.114. p2 bottom (0,1)+(0,5) threat cells + col-4 threats + must-block: F1 0.131, AUROC 0.60, sim share 0.07 (best). p3 bottom 2-3-4 shape only: F1 0.09, P 0.25. p4 late-game col-4-open: F1 0.114. Minimal pairs confirm the bottom-row shape (the same shape shifted to 1-3 or 3-5 does not fire) but tiny positions also fire unpredictably (2,5,0,2 2.18 vs 0,5,0,2 -0.24). Looks polysemantic or random. Synth 5.134 beats dev max 5.077.
